item.title: The Patricia Emerald preserves a 632-carat crystal
item.description:
GEM HISTORY: The emerald crystal comes from Colombia's Chivor mine.
EXIMUTC view: consider a crystal's form and documented provenance before cutting. Carat weight alone should not guide that decision.
Source: www.gia.edu https://www.gia.edu/gems-gemology/summer-2016-rainier-footsteps-journey-chivor-emerald-mine
